extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts, containing 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains (e.g., web, SVG, games, simulations) with automated multimodal evaluation using staged screenshots and checklist-guided MLLM-as-Judge scoring.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.citeAs: Tencent Hunyuan Team. (2025). ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2507.04952v2.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement. Candidates aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Prompt rewriting by experts for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Tasks solved only by brittle hacks (e.g., hard-coded coordinates that break under minor viewport changes) are revised or removed.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness). Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators for checklist calibration. Human validation study on 280 queries with multiple front-end engineers following double-blind protocol. Agreement measured by Pair ACC.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Multiple front-end engineers with extensive development experience
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B as MLLM-as-Judge referees. Hunyuan-Turbos for checklist generation. Playwright (headless Chromium) for execution and screenshot capture.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Privacy dimension in quality filtering ensures queries avoid requesting or involving any sensitive personal information, such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current methodology evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing screenshots at fixed intervals, which may not fully capture fluidity, correctness, and robustness of entire interactive experience for highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. Does not assess LLM's capability to function as autonomous agent for iterative refinement based on feedback.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on generating interactive visual artifacts across diverse prompts. Training, testing, and benchmarking models for visual code generation capabilities. Fine-grained capability analysis across difficulty tiers and task categories.
